answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a voyage as the anchor of the cost.
